business.overview: Comprehensive overview of business development and evaluation

credits.description: Buy credits to unlock unlimited access to our smart tools. Accelerator features an innovative credit-based economy: users buy credits to generate smart models and launch ideas. Other users vote on these ideas using credits — rewarding idea creators with redeemable credits as profits, creating a circular value system.

credits.credits_info: Credits do not expire and can be used across all smart tools. Unused credits carry over to your next purchases.
